    JBL PartyBox Encore Rental Agreement

    This agreement is entered into between the parties named below.

    Owner: —

    1. Rental Package

    The rental package includes:

    • 1 × JBL PartyBox Encore Speaker
    • 2 × Wireless Microphones w/ batteries
    • 2 × Microphone Covers
    • 1 × Charger/Power Adapter
    • 1 × Carrying Bag/Case

    The Renter acknowledges receiving the above items in good working condition unless otherwise stated in this agreement.

    2. Rental Period and Rate

    Selected rate: —

    The rental period starts at the agreed release/delivery time and ends at the agreed return time. Any extension must be approved by the Owner before the original return deadline and may incur additional charges.

    3. Pick-up / Ship by Courier

    The Renter will pick up the equipment directly from the Owner. No delivery fee applies.

    4. Identification Requirements

    Before release, the Renter provided a valid government ID, a photo holding that ID, and a recent utility/official bill showing their complete address. These documents are used solely for rental verification and handled in line with applicable privacy laws.

    5. Care and Responsibility

    The Renter agrees to use the equipment responsibly, keep it away from water, rain, heat and other damaging conditions, and not to open, modify, repair, tamper with, lend, sub-rent, sell or transfer the equipment without the Owner's permission.

    6. Damage, Loss, or Missing Items

    The Renter is responsible for the equipment throughout the rental period and shall cover the repair or replacement cost of anything lost, stolen, damaged through misuse or negligence, or returned with missing parts. Normal wear and tear not caused by the Renter is excluded.

    7. Late Return

    Late returns may incur ₱600 per additional day, at the Owner's discretion for any unauthorized extension.

    8. Payment / Deposit

    Rental Fee₱0.00
    Downpayment (50% of rental fee)₱0.00
    Security Deposit₱0.00
    Initial Payment (due before pick-up)₱0.00
    Balance (due on delivery)₱0.00

    The downpayment and security deposit together make up the initial payment, due before the item is picked up. The remaining balance is paid upon delivery of the item. The security deposit, if applicable, is returned after the equipment is received and inspected, provided there are no outstanding charges, damage, or missing items.
